messages:
priya: Heads-up — we need a final decision on embeddings batching / dims / response format for next-week launch. Customer asks: 1) 1536 dim, 2) bulk upload ~10k docs, 3) stable ids + per-vector metadata.

jason: Quick q — do we want to allow 10k docs in a single request? runtime currently caps by vector count & payload bytes. Right now we generally limit to 2048 vectors per request in Dedicated benchmarks.

marta: Benchmarks update: 2048 x 1536 floats spikes GPU memory on our shared Hosted pool. For 1536 dim realistic p99 for 1024 vectors is ~200ms on our tuned kernel; 2048 only works in Dedicated with lower concurrency.

sam: Proposed tradeoffs: default model = "rw-emb-1" (1536). Set max_vectors_per_request=1024 and max_payload_bytes=8MB for Hosted. Offer a cheaper "rw-emb-1-768" (768 dim) option. For Private/Dedicated offer configurable higher caps (eg 4096). Also expose response format options: JSON array (list<float>) and a compact binary mode (base64 float16).

priya: Launch criteria checklist: SDK support for list/ndarray inputs, clear 413/400 errors for exceeding limits, migration guide, perf benchmarks published, and customer beta (Acme + SearchCo) validated.

jason: About response format — array<float> is easiest for customers to inspect/debug. base64 float16 saves bandwidth but makes quick debugging harder. Do we want both?

marta: We can support hybrid. Suggestion: default to JSON list<float> for small batches (<50 vectors). For larger responses return a compact payload: top-level manifest plus base64-encoded floats per-item. Example response shape: ```{\n  "model":"rw-emb-1",\n  "format":"b64:f16",\n  "data":[{"id":"doc1","b64":"...","meta":{"source":"s3://...","chunk":0}}, ...]\n}``` This keeps metadata per-vector while reducing bytes.

priya: :thumbsup: hybrid sounds good. Also require per-vector metadata fields: id, source, chunk_index optional. Add recommendation for chunking strategy in docs.

sam: Operational notes: for Private/Dedicated we should allow operator-configurable max_vectors (up to 4096) and max_payload_bytes. Need rollout flag and migration path. Also add server-side backpressure error (429) when batching queue full.

jason: Edge cases: dimension mismatch in request -> 400 with helpful message, unknown model -> 404, and when users request both json and b64 -> return preferred format header. Also consider an accept header like `Accept: application/x-embeddings+json` or `application/x-embeddings+proto` later.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR #3281 created: feature/embeddings-batching. CI: perf tests failing at 1536 dim / 1024 concurrency step.

marta: I'll dive into the perf failure — suspect kernel selection (cuBLAS vs custom GEMM) on the new runtime. Might be a quantization path bug for float16 packing.

priya: Next steps: jason to update API contract + error codes (include sample responses), sam to add deployment knobs and config flags, marta to run perf matrix and investigate the CI failure. Sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to lock limits and finalize docs. Thanks everyone!
